notes.title: Utopia Colony - Update
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1233170/Utopia_Colony/]Utopia Colony[/url] has got an update!

Mars is a hazardous place to operate. There is now a crashed spaceship in the Utopia Basin plains. It is unknown what happened to the crew, hopefully they made it ok. One have to be very careful when one operates equipment on Mars. If something malfunctions and breaks, you cannot simply call out for help and expect to get assistance -- there may not be anyone that get the emergency message, and even if they do, there may not be anything they can do to help. So, always make sure to take extra care of the equipment and machinery to make sure it doesn't malfunction or break.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711533/1ce71e332cbc7ec4ca42a5abc5a8af9233127a30.jpg[/img]

We have also added a new music soundtrack. The new music soundtrack is a 2 minutes long cheerful music piece that is consistent with the Utopia Colony music. A goal with the music is to match the eery and very different atmosphere of Mars. We hope you enjoy it!

We hope to see you on Mars!

notes.title: Utopia Colony - Update
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1233170/Utopia_Colony/]Utopia Colony[/url] has got an update!

We have expanded the Utopia Planitia basin area with a new large distant area:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711533/a93845acb6173cb9283e9d33b80906f409f7919c.png[/img]

Known only as Sector 7, this area has been found to have valuable ore deposits that can be mined. You'll need a Hopper to get there. Upgrade your main base to the highest level and then you will be able to get a Hopper rocket. Check it out:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711533/a0141845206e094465dcc3bb5629630146096c15.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711533/56a9369db3596a518aa7715cb4707f97dc89cab0.jpg[/img]

A fuel consuming beast to be sure, but going forward this piece of hardware will be essential for going to the many new Utopia Planitia areas we will be expanding into. Utopia Planitia is a huge area. With a diameter of 3300 km (i.e., 2050 miles), it is the largest know impact basin in the Solar System. Endless places to scan and mine for ore. Just don't get lost in the "Nowhere Plains".

Also, check out the music.. We have added 4 new tunes in this update!

Please let us know what you think about these updates in the Steam Community Hub... We value all the input we can get, it helps a lot..

Further, Utopia Colony is a part of the Base Builder Fest on Steam this week:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711533/ecc2505d85c11f2d6f23ec92f658feebbe0b137f.jpg[/img]

We offer our Base Builder Games at a significant discount during the Base Builder Fest. This a nice time to get Utopia Colony or one of our bundles (see below)..

Utopia Colony will remain in Early Access while we expand the game into new areas in Utopia Planitia. The purpose of Early Access on Steam is to enable game developers, like us, to sell the game while it is being developed and to gather input/feedback from users.

We would appreciate it, and it would help us, if more users perhaps could:
[list]
[*] Give us input / feedback in the Community Hub on Steam. The feedback could be anything you like. Things you'd like to see added, see less of, etc. We have a questionnaire that can be filled out. Perhaps also respond to other peoples posts to voice opinions, support them, etc..
[*] Buy Utopia Colony and Belt Colony, if you are interested in the games..
[*] Give us a thumbs up and/or write a positive review, if you like the game.
[*] Stream or share videos on YouTube or Twitch.
[*] Perhaps retweet one of our Twitter posts: https://twitter.com/utopiacolony
[/list]
Our intent/purpose/goal with these games is simple.. We want to make Utopia Colony and Belt Colony a fun, interesting, and entertaining series of space mining and outpost building sim games. We need help to make this a reality, and we appreciate anything you can do..

Utopia Colony is being co-developed with another Early Access game called Belt Colony. Belt Colony is kind of like a sequel to Utopia Colony that is set in the Asteroid Belt. Both games share the same back-stories, and are both space mining and outpost building sim games. Co-developing the games is a new strategy or way of thinking, that we are excited about. We think it'll help us to develop, and understand, the games from a broader perspective, when we develop them concurrently, than if we simply develop them one-by-one. We would also appreciate high-level views, feature requests, and opinions regarding both games, in the Community Hub.

We recently made bundles for our games on Steam to make it easier to purchase the games:
[list]
[*] The Miner Bundle consists of Utopia Colony and Belt Colony that are currently being co-developed.
[*] The All Games Bundle consists of all our games.
[/list]
It is also possible to buy a bundle if you have one or more of the games from before.

Here are links to the bundles:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28238/Miner_Bundle/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28248/All_Games_Bundle/

Stay tuned. More improvements are coming. We hope to see you on Mars!

notes.title: Utopia Colony - Update
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1233170/Utopia_Colony/]Utopia Colony[/url] has got an update!

We have added more sound effects, improved animations, and improved the loading process. These are a few updates to make the game experience better, based on feedback from players.

Going forward, we have decided to co-develop Utopia Colony with another game we recently launched in Early Access on Steam, called Belt Colony. Co-developing the games is a new strategy or way of thinking, that we are excited about. We think it may help us to develop, and understand, the games from a broader perspective than if we simply develop them one-by-one.. Currently, Utopia Colony and Belt Colony have a similar set of features, concepts, background stories, etc., but, the main content (e.g. 3D models), etc. are different. This is a part of the plan going forward... Different ways of mining, for example, could be used in both games, even though 3D models, etc., are different.. For us as developers, it is also quite helpful to be able to take a step back and see these space miners of the near future from a whole new perspective and to discuss this with another set of user perspectives. We see already now from feedback that this gives us a whole new perspective, especially a broader perspective, on what would be better games...

We made a update video for this purpose, at the launch event for Belt Colony in Las Vegas recently:

[previewyoutube=WMqhheYEAPU;full][/previewyoutube]

The purpose of Early Access on Steam is to enable game developers, like us, to sell the game while it is being developed and to gather input/feedback from users. We have been struggling with reviews lately, and we have got very few new users, and input from new users, as a consequence of this.

We would appreciate it, and it would help us, if more users perhaps could:
[list]
[*] Give us input / feedback in the Community Hub on Steam. The feedback could be anything you like. Things you'd like to see added, see less of, etc. We have a questionnaire that can be filled out. Perhaps also respond to other peoples posts to voice opinions, support them, etc..
[*] Buy Utopia Colony and Belt Colony, if you are interested in the games. There are many who have the game(s) wishlisted, so we guess many are waiting until the game is finished or get further along.
[*] Give us a thumbs up / write a positive review, if you like the game. Reviews are very important on Steam and directly affects new user growth.
[/list]
Our intent/purpose/goal with these games is simple.. We want to make Utopia Colony and Belt Colony a fun, interesting, and entertaining series of space mining and outpost building sim games. We need help to make this a reality, and we appreciate anything you can do.

We recently made bundles for our games on Steam to make it easier to purchase the games:
[list]
[*] The Miner Bundle consists of Utopia Colony and Belt Colony that are currently being co-developed.
[*] The All Games Bundle consists of all our games.
[/list]
It is also possible to buy a bundle if you have one or more of the games from before.

notes.title: Utopia Colony - Update
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1233170/Utopia_Colony/]Utopia Colony[/url] has got an update!

We have added a new building for the main base area. The Atmospheric Extractor building is quite big. Its seven story height makes it a towering construction. The ground floor has storage tanks and a UI that can be used to refine vapor gas into refined HyCarb or water. Take the elevator to the top of the building. This is where you will find the UI for activating the vapor collector. Large fins will spin rapidly and collect vapor from the atmosphere. The vapor collector requires a lot of power, so you have to ensure that power levels are sufficient before activating it. Also, make sure to look out for dust storms. Dust storms can do damage to the collector fins and intake nozzles.

Stay tuned. More improvements are coming. We hope to see you on Mars!

notes.title: Utopia Colony - Update

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1233170/Utopia_Colony/]Utopia Colony[/url] has got an update!

Utopia Colony now supports buying and placing an Outpost. The Outpost can be acquired as soon as you have got a Carryall Rover. The Outpost is initially put on the flatbed Carryall Rover and must be hauled out to a location where you would like to place it. Press the E key when driving the rover to deploy the Outpost. Once deployed, you can enter the Outpost to purchase extractors and other upgrades. There is no longer a need to drive all the way back to the main base for such things. When you are finished with a location, it is a simple matter to disassemble the Outpost and load it back up on the Carryall Rover where you can haul it out to a different location.

notes.title: Utopia Colony - Update
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1233170/Utopia_Colony/]Utopia Colony[/url] has got an update!

Utopia Colony now supports placeable base buildings. When you buy a building that can be placed in any location, you will now see an above the base view of the placeable area. Drag & drop the building to the place you would like it to be, rotate it, and click finish. The terrain is automatically dug out to fit the newly placed building. If you are not happy with the placement, don't worry, you can move all building when the placing mode is active, and you can also move the buildings at any time later (for some credits).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711533/57403a6edc9f8d80be61fc2119ead128d7fb5167.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711533/5050296d3b103bc419413809093e313edd36d857.jpg[/img]

The pic above shows how your base can look with some of the placeable buildings we currently support:[list]
[*] Greenhouse -- produces vegetables, fruits, etc.
[*] Storage -- stores ore, volatiles, etc.
[*] Metal refinery -- refines metal ore
[*] Composites refinery -- refines composites
[/list]

We have also added some other improvements:[list]
[*] Recover rovers -- Got your rovers stuck? Get rover assistance for a few credits.
[*] Marketplace -- Buy and sell refined composites and metal ingots.
[*] Base models -- We have made some minor fixes to the main base models.
[*] Map -- We made some minor fixes to the area map (in the base).
[/list]

Stay tuned. More improvements are coming. We hope to see you on Mars!

You can now add a basement to the main base. The basement holds a moderately powerful fusion reactor capable of powering the station and more. A fusion reactor is a new piece of technology in 2033. A set of closely regulated high energy antimatter particle beams are used to generate the conditions that are used to enable fusion reactions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711533/43644988bb0180afe105f8daace4adddd2e059cc.jpg[/img]

The terrain has also been improved with more landscaping rocks. These rocks are aesthetics to make the landscape look more realistic. These rocks cannot be mined. You will find these rocks spread out in the terrain and they make nice places for a little sightseeing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711533/1b63269f2cbf1f8cb35b61715598d42cbf792052.jpg[/img]

We have also made a few more improvements to the game:
[list]
[*] The settings now has invert Y for user input.
[*] The running speed has been slightly reduced in the main base.
[*] The jumping factor has been reduced in the main base to avoid hitting the ceiling when jumping.
[/list]

Stay tuned. More improvements are coming. We hope to see you on Mars!

notes.title: Utopia Colony - Update
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1233170/Utopia_Colony/]Utopia Colony[/url] has got an update!

Need to haul big loads? No problem. There is now a Carryall Rover available for purchase, if you've got the credits... Hauling mining rigs, research equipment, etc., is no longer any problem. No need to ask for help from the colonies, you can now do it all yourself. The Carryall Rover, a 3 ton, flat bed, six wheeler is what you need, in addition to the smaller but faster Explorer Rover. You've got to check this one out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711533/2c96088319dc4952f077d3600d0b1ddf87becec6.jpg[/img]

Running out of rocks to mine? We have added deployable Rock Extractors. There is an area, not far from the base, that is suitable for rock extraction mining. Deploy Rock Extractors and get a steady supply of rock ore that can be mined. We think Rock Extractors is a valuable addition to the gameplay experience.

We have got requests for more dust. Well we decided to really turn it up. Look around and you'll see tiny particles of dust whirling about everywhere, making for a more realistic Mars atmosphere..

Xbox Controller support has now been added. Just plug-in your Xbox Controller and start playing. The whole game can be operated using a Xbox Controller: the main game, menus, in-game menus, etc. You do not need to use keyboard or mouse, only the controller.

There are also various minor improvements, enhancements and bug fixes. We hope to see you on Mars!

notes.title: Utopia Colony - Update
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1233170/Utopia_Colony/]Utopia Colony[/url] has got an update!

We have updated Utopia Colony to include a solar flare event. Solar flare events are dangerous on Mars due to the thin atmosphere. The radiation levels on the surface will become too high for people, and it is necessary to find shelter underground. When the solar flare event occurs in the game, you have to go to the Rua 51 underground mine and stay there until surface radiation levels normalize. At Rua 51 there is additional game play that you can engage in while waiting for the solar flare event to pass. We have added more resources. Voice acting has been improved. We hope you come to Mars!

notes.title: Utopia Colony - Update
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1233170/Utopia_Colony/]Utopia Colony[/url] has got an update!

Utopia Colony has now been updated to include dust storms. Be especially careful when you venture far out by foot. A dust storm can appear when you least expect it, and can be very disorienting. If you loose your way in a dust storm, you run the risk of running out of oxygen. We have added more resources in remote places. When roaming Utopia Planitia, you will now find resources in far away places. Voice acting has also been improved, so that there is more variation in the voice dialogues. Look around and you will also see many small improvements and details after this update. Hope to see you on Mars!

This is an Early Access game and we are interested in players joining us in the Community Hub.

notes.title: Utopia Colony - Major Update
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1233170/Utopia_Colony/]Utopia Colony[/url] has got a major update!

Finally it is here! We published today our second Early Access release of Utopia Colony. We use a new terrain that is easier to traverse by foot and rover. The terrain is 7x larger than before, so feel free to roam in the rover! We replaced the main character. The previous character was a bit too army for a Mars game, so we replaced it with a female astronaut that we feel is much more appropriate for the game setting. We have added more things you can deploy. You can now use extractors to extract water, hydrocarbon, and deuterium ore. We have also added voice acting, and many new details. We hope you join us on Mars!

This is an Early Access game and we are interested in players joining us in the Community Hub.
